name: federation-platform
description: Small federated GraphQL platform: Rust Hive Router plugin, TypeScript subgraphs, CI schema governance.

scripts.graph:update: pnpm --filter "./subgraphs/*" --filter "!@federation-platform/node" --if-present run schema:generate && pnpm --filter @federation-platform/node run sync && pnpm --filter @federation-platform/governance run compose
scripts.check:router: cd router && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
